card.name: Second digit in reference and date numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit that is the second or later digit of a multi-digit number, such as 59, 29, 08 or 10. It appears in citation numbers, claim or list numbering, and dates or URLs.

modes.label: Citation and list numbers
modes.description: The last digit of a two-digit reference, claim or item number.

modes.label: Digits inside dates and URLs
modes.description: A digit within a date or a web address.

card.plain: It fires on the second digit of a number like a reference number or a date, and does not depend on the medical content.
